title_sq: Tek Rezidenca Kodra E Diellit, Shitet Super Apartament 3+1+2+Verande, I Investuar !
description_sq: Tek Rezidenca Kodra E Diellit, Shitet Super Apartament 3+1+2+Verande, I Investuar !! Apartamenti me siperfaqe totale 218 m², nga te cilat 129.7 apartament dhe 89 m2 verande, ndodhet ne katin e 3 te njeres prej objekteve te Rezidences me fasade termike dhe cilesi te larte ndertimi. Organizohet nga salloni i ndenjes bashke me kendin e gatimit, dhoma matrimoniale me tualet me vete, dy dhomat e gjumit te femijeve, tualeti dites dhe veranda. Orientimi i tij eshte Jug-Perendim. Objekti eshte i organizuar me dy kate parkimi nentoke dhe mbi te zhvillohen 6 kate banimi. Disa nga benefitet e kompleksit jane: fasade e ventiluar, dritare me dopjo xham me mbushje me gaz per minimizimin e zhurmave dhe termoizolim, izolim akustik ne ndarjet ndermjet apartamenteve, sistem i pergatitur i ngrohjes qendrore. Oborri i brendshem eshte nje hapesire e plotesuar me stola dhe gjelberim, ne pjesen e pasme te kompleksit, pjesa veri-lindore e tij. Apartamenti shitet sic pasqyrohet ne foto pjeserisht i mobiluar.
title_en: At Kodra E Diellit Residence, Super Apartment 3+1+2+Veranda for sale, Invested!
description_en: At Kodra E Diellit Residence, Super Apartment 3+1+2+Verande, Invested!! The apartment with a total area of ​​218 m², of which 129.7 is an apartment and 89 m2 of a veranda, is located on the 3rd floor of one of the buildings of the Residence with a thermal facade and high quality construction. It is organized by the living room together with the cooking area, the matrimonial room with its own toilet, the two children's bedrooms, the day toilet and the veranda. Its orientation is South-West. The building is organized with two floors of underground parking and 6 residential floors will be developed above. Some of the benefits of the complex are: ventilated facade, double-glazed windows with gas filling to minimize noise and thermal insulation, acoustic insulation in the partitions between apartments, prepared central heating system. The inner courtyard is a space filled with benches and greenery, at the back of the complex, its north-eastern part. The apartment is sold as shown in the photo, partially furnished.
